<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Correction:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty extended losses for a third consecutive session, shedding over 1% as rising crude oil prices and geopolitical tensions in West Asia triggered a broad-based sell-off.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I28</a></span></li>
